auth_type.correction: apiToken: use an account authentication token in X-Auth-Token or the token query parameter; the API Key itself only generates tokens and is not accepted for ordinary API calls.

free_tier_limits.correction: Ubidots STEM is non-commercial only and includes 3 devices, 1 dashboard with 10 widgets, 10 variables/device, 4,000 ingested dots/day, 500,000 extracted dots/day, 1 request/second, and 1-month retention.

rate_limits.correction: Published limits include up to 4 requests/second per token for commercial accounts, fixed at 4 requests/second for device tokens, plus plan-specific account throughput; STEM permits 1 request/second and 4,000 dots/day.

notes: The API and v2 device endpoint remain documented and operational. The entry fails because it misclassifies the required account token as an API Key and says published free-tier and rate limits are unknown or unpublished. CORS behavior was not established from authoritative documentation.
